acceptance_predicates.description: Every selectable multi-choice row has explicit unchecked/checked state and focus is not confused with selection.
Toggle, select-all, clear-all, disabled, and empty behavior is consistent and contextually documented.
Selected values are visually separated from current-item descriptions by a framed pane or stable horizontal rule.
The shared control covers all supported wizard selection domains without free-form substitutes.

definition_of_done: Users can tell what is selected and why, without relying on color or memory of prior screens.

outputs.description: Reusable accessible checkable list and summary/detail layout.

gates.description: Renderer/model/help snapshots prove every selection state and narrow layout.
